name: Sore Yuke! Bell Kage Gakuen
original_name: それゆけ！ベルカゲ学園
source:
Welsh was late when delivering bread for purchase in the morning. When he rushed into the classroom, for some reason he was appointed chairman!

Welsh, who has a strong sense of responsibility, moves to solve the problem, even though he has a somewhat unsatisfactory feeling.

[Translated from [url=http://bellkage.blog.jp/2019_4_1.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
Welsh早上送面包去采购时迟到了。他匆忙冲进教室，却不知为何被任命为班长！

责任感很强的Welsh虽然感到有些不满，仍然行动起来，努力解决问题。

[译自[url=http://bellkage.blog.jp/2019_4_1.html]官方网站[/url]]
